feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 July 2026 11:46am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 23 July 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the west of Ireland, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northwest 4 or 5 for the rest of today, but touching 6 around a few parts of the Isle of Man at first, and decreasing Variable 2 or 3 this afternoon and evening in the southwest of the area, towards Dublin Bay. Becoming West or Northwest 3 or 4 in all waters tonight, with little change tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or slight to moderate, becoming smooth or slight tonight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, backing West or Southwest 4 or 5 later tomorrow, increasing 5 or 6 later tomorrow night or on Saturday morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, gradually building moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy light rain and drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in light rain and drizzle later.
